title: Build SCD Type 2 history
description: Remember what was true, and when.
intro: Overwriting a customer loses their history. These snapshots each represent a change. Turn them into non-overlapping validity intervals so analysts can see a customer as they were at any point in time.
objectives: Use BIGINT customer_id, name, email, valid_from, valid_to, and is_current.
Set valid_from to the parsed updated_at and valid_to to the next update for that customer.
Use half-open intervals [valid_from, valid_to); the current row has NULL valid_to and TRUE is_current.
hints: LEAD(updated_at) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY updated_at) gives the next version’s start.
Compute valid_to in a CTE, then use valid_to IS NULL AS is_current. Each fixture row is a distinct change.
